sentence: Please do not leave your laptop in the kitchen overnight.
synonym: keep your laptop in the kitchen
synonymNote: 两者都表示把笔记本电脑放在厨房里不带走，意思相同

distractors.word: bring your laptop to the kitchen
distractors.note: 意思是把电脑带去厨房，强调移动动作，不是放在那里

distractors.word: use your laptop in the kitchen
distractors.note: 意思是在厨房使用电脑，不是把它留在那里

distractors.word: fix your laptop in the kitchen
distractors.note: 意思是在厨房修理电脑，与原句含义完全不同
